gem.incomingTip:
Incoming damage
The minimum HP you can take this turn — after current block, end-of-turn relics/plating, and playing your hand's block optimally.
gem.offenseTip:
Your damage
The most HP you can deal this turn (cards + damage that lands before your next play).
Hover an enemy to scope to it; the energy gem glows green when you can kill it.
